excelcompare: Compare Excel Files Cell by Cell

Source: R/excelcompare-package.R
excelcompare-package.Rd

Compare Excel files (.xlsx) at the cell level, detecting differences in content across all cells including titles, footnotes, and annotations. Built on 'tidyxl' for comprehensive cell-by-cell comparison that goes beyond tabular data to capture every cell in a worksheet.
